title: UPDATE: Oracle Integrates Codex and ChatGPT Into Enterprise Apps Under Expanded OpenAI Deal
summary:
The software giant is updating its range of business tools to work natively with generative AI models from OpenAI. Under an expanded agreement, Oracle will incorporate the Codex and ChatGPT language models into its corporate software and enable users to access the company's own business applications directly through the ChatGPT interface.

In addition to the software integration, Oracle is introducing new networking capabilities for its Acceleron AI hardware and adding to its cloud chip lineup. These developments follow the company's recent launch of Fusion Companion, a system that allows employees to manage operations in finance, HR and supply chain through AI agents without navigating between separate applications.

$ORCL ANNOUNCES NEW AI PLATFORM THAT LETS CHATGPT EXECUTE ENTERPRISE WORKFLOWS

Oracle introduced Fusion Companion and Fusion Agentic Home at Oracle AI World, allowing employees to manage business operations through AI tools like ChatGPT.

Instead of navigating multiple applications, users can describe what they want done, and the system identifies and coordinates the necessary transactions, workflows, approvals, and AI agents.

The technology works across Oracle's Fusion applications, including finance, HR, supply chain, sales, and customer service, while maintaining enterprise security and permissions.
